title: A weakness has been identified in Drakeling Labs Operation Harsh Doorstop up to 0.14.2.1 Build… (CVE-2026-134536)
description: A vulnerability in Drakeling Labs Operation Harsh Doorstop up to version 0.14.2.1 Build 19523588 allows remote attackers to exploit the LaunchURL function in the Workshop Configuration component to perform unrestricted uploads. This issue is resolved by upgrading to version 0.14.2.2 Build 26092794.
